blurb:
Discover the stunning beauty of Banff National Park with Majestic Banff Experiences. This local tour company offers expertly designed packages that cater to every traveler's taste—from scenic hikes through breathtaking trails to thrilling wildlife encounters. Enjoy the Wonderful experience of sightseeing of Lake louise, Lake Moraine, Emerald Lake, Natural Bridge over the Kicking horse river in Yoho National Park and a Hike stop at Johnston Canyon.

- Explore breathtaking trails with guided hiking tours
- Enjoy serene lake adventures, including canoeing
- Encounter wildlife in their natural habitat with expert guidance
Moraine Lake is closed from 14 Oct to 1 Jun due to winter conditions for that experience Lake minniwanka and Two- jack.
